accessCheck.scope: Authenticated Git push and Actions REST run/attempt/jobs/logs/artifacts/full-rerun access verified.
accessCheck.launchCapability: Scoped feature-branch workflow push followed by explicit complete workflow reruns; no main change or deployment.

comparisonPolicy: Keep all attempts and every successful run, including slow successes. Five matched final runs and equivalent-coverage stage mapping are required; rerun baseline if runner/toolchain/cache conditions drift. Relocated consumer work is not an engine speedup.
measurementMethod: Five fresh hosted jobs, sequential complete workflow reruns identified by (runId, attempt), at one immutable workflow revision and exact frozen checkout. Queue-excluded wall time uses job started_at/completed_at; stage durations use API step timestamps at one-second resolution. Null duration means skipped, never measured zero. Artifact bytes are per-attempt API compressed archive sizes.
workflowAdjustments: Exact frozen checkout; original 14 verification/upload blocks preserved.
Removed showcase Pages upload and deployment job; read-only contents permission.
Added environment logging and 30-minute hang guard.
Added bootstrap push limited to the existing feature branch and workflow path; main merge does not trigger it.
Artifact name includes attempt to retain all rerun artifacts; payload paths are unchanged.
requiredStageNames: Build a clean installed content consumer
Preserve assertion and screenshot failures through cleanup
Reject successful validation when cleanup fails
Run installed content at root and nested bases
retentionLimit: Attempt 2 raw job logs and artifact metadata are retained, but its ZIP became unavailable on rerun before download. Other available archives are hash-checked; selected diagnostics are committed, full ZIPs remain ignored local output.

environmentMatching.matchingRequirement: Final five measurements must match the baseline environment/cache policy and coverage mapping; otherwise remeasure the baseline. Failed-attempt environments are recorded separately and excluded from the success median.
environmentMatching.costComparisonStatus: Not evaluated. These are recorded baseline measurements, not a controlled comparison or final budget pass. Match all five final environment/cache conditions or remeasure the frozen baseline under final conditions; do not discard successful samples to select a preferred image.
